article.title: AI Agents Need Boundaries, Not Just Better Prompts

paragraphs.en: An AI agent can plan steps, use tools, and update systems. This makes it more useful than a chatbot that only drafts text, but it also creates operational risks. A prompt asking an agent to be careful is not a security boundary. Reliable agents need explicit permissions, clear transaction limits, observable state transitions, and safe recovery paths. The design should distinguish reading data, proposing an action, and actually committing a change.
paragraphs.zh: 本段討論「AI Agents Need Boundaries, Not Just Better Prompts」的實務含義：先理解問題與決策背景。 重要的是將觀察到的現象與真正需要採取的行動分開，並留下可供驗證的依據。
paragraphs.ja: 「AI Agents Need Boundaries, Not Just Better Prompts」について、業務上の前提と意思決定を確認する。まず課題と背景を理解する。 観察事実と実際に取るべき行動を区別し、検証可能な根拠を残すことが重要である。

paragraphs.en: Consider a payment workflow. The agent may read an invoice, classify an expense, and propose a transfer, but the final payment should require a separately authorized action. If the network fails after a request is sent, the system must check whether the payment was already recorded before retrying. Otherwise a well-intentioned recovery attempt could create a duplicate transaction. A durable identifier and audit log help reconstruct the event.
paragraphs.zh: 本段討論「AI Agents Need Boundaries, Not Just Better Prompts」的實務含義：必須確認條件、風險與後續行動，不能只依賴單一表面指標。 重要的是將觀察到的現象與真正需要採取的行動分開，並留下可供驗證的依據。
paragraphs.ja: 「AI Agents Need Boundaries, Not Just Better Prompts」について、業務上の前提と意思決定を確認する。条件、リスク、次の対応を整理し、一つの指標だけで判断しない。 観察事実と実際に取るべき行動を区別し、検証可能な根拠を残すことが重要である。
